trailAreas.name: Owen Sound Side Trail
trailAreas.desc: Daily access from home. Limestone outcrops, cedar groves, and the escarpment edge above town. Best in early morning fog.

trailAreas.name: Inglis Falls Area
trailAreas.desc: One of the best waterfall sections on the escarpment. Rock shelves and fossil beds along the Sydenham River.

trailAreas.name: Walters Falls to Eugenia
trailAreas.desc: Deep forest and open escarpment views. Hidden caves and seasonal streams through the Beaver Valley corridor.

prints.title: Morning Fog — Owen Sound Escarpment

prints.title: Georgian Bay Cedar Shore
prints.desc: 16×20 canvas. Limited run of 20. Signed and numbered.

art.title: Escarpment Edge — Autumn
art.desc: Hot wax and pigment on wood panel. The light that comes sideways through old maple in October.

art.title: Georgian Bay Shoreline
art.desc: Oil on canvas. The cold blue of Georgian Bay on a November morning. Cedar leaning over flat rock.

art.title: Cave Light — Section 31
art.desc: Encaustic on panel. The way light enters a small cave mouth in afternoon. Found on the trail, not on any map.

gear.name: Approach Trail Boot
gear.review: Four seasons on the Bruce Trail and still going. The limestone edge sections in wet weather are where most boots fail — these grip. Good Canadian value.
